--- a/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
@@ -39,15 +39,32 @@ class Dependant:
     background_tasks_param_name: Optional[str] = None
     security_scopes_param_name: Optional[str] = None
     security_scopes: Optional[List[str]] = None
+    own_oauth_scopes: Optional[List[str]] = None
     use_cache: bool = True
     path: Optional[str] = None
     scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None
 
+    @cached_property
+    def _uses_scopes(self) -> bool:
+        if self.own_oauth_scopes:
+            return True
+        if self.security_scopes_param_name is not None:
+            return True
+        if isinstance(self.call, SecurityBase):
+            return True
+        for sub_dep in self.dependencies:
+            if sub_dep._uses_scopes:
+                return True
+        return False
+
     @cached_property
     def cache_key(self) -> DependencyCacheKey:
+        scopes_for_cache = (
+            tuple(sorted(set(self.security_scopes or []))) if self._uses_scopes else ()
+        )
         return (
             self.call,
-            tuple(sorted(set(self.security_scopes or []))),
+            scopes_for_cache,
             self.computed_scope or "",
         )
